filename: T1 - Tentorium cerebelli meningioma posterior fossa , tentorium cerebelli 003.jpg
description: There is a solid lesion on the right superior aspect of the posterior fossa keeping a broad base within the tentorium cerebelli, but also with a doubtful invasion of the adjacent cerebellar folia on the multiplanar reformatted images. The lesion is isointense on T1 and hyperintense to the cerebral cortex on T2; it shows a bright contrast enhancement and mild homogeneous restricted diffusion.
